business_problem: Assisto needed to analyze high volumes of multilingual, code-mixed customer calls in real time so enterprises could extract sentiment, emotion, and actionable insights without relying on slow manual transcription and review.
solution_summary: Assisto integrated IBM watsonx.ai and fine-tuned IBM Granite large language models into its iAssist conversational AI platform to create a more human-like multilingual voice bot. Assisto's in-house automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech engines transcribe and vocalize code-mixed customer speech, then watsonx.ai detects sentiment and emotion in real time while the Granite models improve response quality for multilingual interactions. The platform also generates call summaries and performs contextual text analysis so customer-service teams can understand each conversation faster. To operationalize those insights, IBM Cognos Analytics aggregates issue trends, sentiment patterns, and agent performance into a unified dashboard. This architecture transforms raw audio into structured business intelligence, giving banking, telecom, insurance, and retail customers better conversational automation and visibility into what callers are experiencing across every voice-based touchpoint.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai

solution_components.name: IBM Granite
solution_components.role: Supplies the fine-tuned large language models that improve response quality in code-mixed interactions.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics

data_flow: Customer calls are transcribed by Assisto's ASR layer, watsonx.ai and Granite analyze the text for intent, sentiment, emotion, and response generation, the platform produces summaries and contextual text analysis, and Cognos Analytics presents the resulting insights to support teams through a unified dashboard.
business_outcome: Assisto helped enterprises reduce transcription effort and support costs while increasing customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement through more inclusive multilingual voice interactions and richer call analytics.
metrics: 60%–70% reduction in time spent on manual transcription
